svg.title: Knuckle-boom crane truck — Vörubíll með liðkrana
svg.desc: A flatbed truck carries a compact folding crane with a sharply articulated elbow and short hanging hook.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-knuckle-boom-truck","label_en":"Knuckle-boom crane truck","label_is":"Vörubíll með liðkrana","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","truck-crane"],"description":"A flatbed truck carries a compact folding crane with a sharply articulated elbow and short hanging hook.","design_note":"The folded knuckle boom over a cargo bed is distinct from a long straight mobile-crane boom.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
